billing.legal.description: Review the service terms before saving. Acceptance time, user, and document version are stored as an auditable record.
billing.legal.termsSummary: General terms for ContextHub Cloud use, tenant subscriptions, and recurring payments
billing.legal.termsProvider: ContextHub Cloud is the managed SaaS product provided at ctxhub.net by İKONX Bilişim ve Tarım Sanayi ve Ticaret Ltd. Şti. ikon-x.com.tr is the company’s corporate website.
billing.legal.termsCompanyDetails: Registered address: Akdeniz Mh. Şehit Fethibey Cd. No:55-91 Konak/İzmir 35210, Türkiye · Konak Tax Office · Tax No: 4701114216 · MERSIS No: 0470111421600001 · Trade Registry/File No: 210240.
billing.legal.termsScope: A subscription belongs to the selected tenant and does not grant plan or quota rights to other tenants.
billing.legal.termsBilling: Monthly/yearly charges, taxes, and renewal details are finalized at checkout and on the invoice. Enterprise terms follow the signed quote or contract.
billing.legal.termsQuota: Plan limits and acceptable-use rules apply. Fixed plans do not create automatic overage charges unless explicitly enabled.
billing.legal.termsInfrastructure: To provide availability, performance, security, and disaster recovery, the service may use distributed cloud, backup, CDN, and edge infrastructure in regions outside Türkiye, including EU/EEA countries. Depending on the service, content and personal data may be stored, cached, or processed in those regions.
billing.legal.termsCancellation: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the period; prior invoices and accrued payment obligations remain due. Data is not automatically deleted at cancellation.
billing.legal.termsSecurity: Users are responsible for account and access security. Illegal use, abuse, and activity that threatens service security are prohibited.
billing.legal.privacySummary: Information about personal data processed for billing and payments
billing.legal.privacyController: The data controller and service provider for ContextHub Cloud is İKONX Bilişim ve Tarım Sanayi ve Ticaret Ltd. Şti. ctxhub.net is the product domain and ikon-x.com.tr is the corporate domain.
billing.legal.privacyPurpose: Identity, contact, tax, and address data is processed to establish the contract, invoice, collect payment, keep accounts, provide support, maintain security, and meet legal duties.
billing.legal.privacyRecipients: Necessary data may be shared, for these limited purposes, with payment providers, invoicing/accounting services, infrastructure providers, and authorized public bodies located in Türkiye or abroad.
billing.legal.privacyInternationalTransf: Personal data may be transferred to service providers abroad, including in EU/EEA countries, to provide hosting, backup, security, support, and edge/CDN services, subject to appropriate transfer mechanisms under Article 9 of Türkiye’s Personal Data Protection Law and applicable technical and organizational safeguards. Distributed edge locations may process limited connection, IP/device, security-log, and cache data needed to serve a request.
billing.legal.privacyBasis: Data is collected directly from you through this electronic form and relies on contract formation/performance, legal duties, and legitimate interests. This notice is not a request for consent.
billing.legal.privacyRights: Send access, correction, and other data-subject requests to support@ctxhub.net. Corporate information is available at ikon-x.com.tr.
